children: Kenneth W. Lowe, a Director, reported a sale of Series A common stock on September 3, 2026. The filing notes a weighted average selling price of $28.35 per share for the transactions. The total reported sale amount was $5,670,000. Following the sale, Lowe directly owns 790,108 shares and indirectly owns 793 shares held by The Lowe Family Trust. The filing states the price range for the multiple transactions was $28.30 to $28.45 and provides related trust and ownership footnotes.
